newsitem.title: UK: ROWING-REDGRAVE WILL MAKE DECISION ON SYDNEY IN NEXT TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: ROWING-REDGRAVE WILL MAKE DECISION ON SYDNEY IN NEXT TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Rower Steve Redgrave, who won his fourth consecutive Olympic title in Atlanta, will decide within the next two months whether to try for a fifth title at the 2000 Sydney Olympics.
Redgrave, 34, and Matthew Pinsent won the coxless pairs title in Atlanta, Britain's only gold medal of the Games.
Immediately after the victory, Redgrave said he would not be competing in Sydney but he has subsequently hinted that he might change his mind.
"I know it's going to be a very big decision to give up," Redgrave told reporters on Wednesday. "I'm very, very tempted to go to Sydney...I'll make a decision in the next couple of months."
